history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of Process Booking Cancellation function.
features: In UC14, the Carrier reviews the booking cancellation request and decides whether to Confirm or Decline it. UC14 is allowed only against UC13 data, and only the UC13 record in DCSA Booking Activity can be processed.

A new right-click option [Cancellation Confirmed] is provided in DCSA Booking Activity. The system asks the agency user for remarks and confirms the cancellation. When the user chooses this option, the AFSYS+ booking has already been CANCELLED. The system:
•	Calls PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, which calls WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT and passes the user remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	Triggers the ‘REJE’/‘BKG’ TnT event for UC14, using the same parameters as UC10 and ‘booking cancelled’.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to CANCELLATION CONFIRMED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status is updated to CANCELLED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].
A new right-click option [Cancellation Declined] is provided in DCSA Booking Activity. The system asks the agency user for remarks and declines the shipper’s UC13 cancellation request. The system:
•	Calls PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, which calls WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT and passes the user remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to CANCELLATION DECLINED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status keeps its previous status [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].

events.description: Opens the "Cancellation Confirmed" pop-up for the selected booking request.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Cancellation Confirmed" in the row's ☰ menu in the DCSA Activity grid.
events.remarks: "Do you want to Cancellation Confirmed this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

events.description: Blocks the action if the record is not a UC13 (cancellation received) record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Cancellation Confirmed" and the precondition is not met.

events.description: Calls PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT with the remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS and triggers the ‘REJE’/‘BKG’ TnT event (‘booking cancelled’); updates current event = CANCELLATION CONFIRMED, status = CANCELLED.
events.triggered_when: User enters the reason and clicks Yes.

events.description: Opens the "Cancellation Declined" pop-up for the selected booking request.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Cancellation Declined" in the row's ☰ menu in the DCSA Activity grid.
events.remarks: "Do you want to Cancellation Declined this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

events.description: Blocks the action if the record is not a UC13 (cancellation received) record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Cancellation Declined" and the precondition is not met.

events.description: Calls PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT with the remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS; updates current event = CANCELLATION DECLINED, status unchanged.
events.triggered_when: User enters the reason and clicks Yes.

rows.remarks: Calls event triggering and TnT event on Yes

rows.ui: Shows the selected DCSA Request ID
rows.values: "Do you want to Cancellation Confirmed this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

rows.name: Reason for Cancellation Confirmed

rows.name: Cancellation Declined

rows.name: Confirmation Text
rows.ui: Shows the selected DCSA Request ID
rows.values: "Do you want to Cancellation Declined this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

rows.name: Reason for Cancellation Declined
rows.ui: Input the reason for cancellation decline

rows.name: Yes
